doctrines.note: COMBINED THREAD: OP's own 'Units covered' line names only Imperial Javelineers + Elite Javelin Sergeants (the unit tracked here as javelin-sergeants / tierlist label 'Javelin Sergeants'); no mention of Retiarii or Laconic Javelins appears anywhere in the OP text despite an outside claim they're also covered — not asserted here, flagged as unconfirmed. Doctrines/build/playstyle are shared advice for both covered units except where the OP explicitly splits veterancy. Veterancy (unit-specific split in OP): Elite Javelin Sergeants go Top or Bot — after the unit's buff, Amya prefers the damage boost of Bot over double-shot from Top (Imperial Javelineers' own veterancy, Top Line, is a different unit and out of scope for this record). Hero pairing: literal X placeholder in the OP — not specified, not fabricated. Example build (shared): Javelin Doctrine (immobilize 1.5s), Javelin Doctrine (+250 dmg/+30 ammo), Javelin Doctrine (+300 block break/+100 piercing), Polearm Doctrine, Unit Damage Doctrine V. "Origin" is a literal X placeholder in the OP. Edit timestamp (2026-05-26) pre-dates the 2026-06-25 Chaos patch anchor; doctrine/build guidance flagged for revalidation against current season (not staleAsOfPatch per arbitration ruleset — Javelin Sergeants is not on the 13-unit Chaos shortlist, so no forced flag, but noting pre-patch authorship per instructions).
